newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf chairman sees higher EPS.
newsitem.headline: Elf chairman sees higher EPS.

text.p: The acquisition by Elf Aquitaine group of 4.5 percent of its capital following a state sale of the company's stock will boost earnings per share, Elf chairman Philippe Jaffre said on Wednesday.

"This removes the uncertainty surrounding the French state's interest in the company which has weighed on the share price," he said in a statement. "The acquisition will automatically improve earnings per share."
Earlier, the government said it was selling 24.9 million shares in the energy company for about 10 billion francs.
Elf said the group bought the 4.5 percent stake through its indirectly-owned Fingestval unit.
